text:
kevin: Hey team — Catalyst Labs just paid invoice #5421 but the invoice PDF that went out is missing their PO number (they provided PO CL-2024-019). Customer is requesting a reissued invoice and a credit/rebill. Can we confirm process and ETA?

maria: Ack, looking. Do we have the original payment/settlement ID?

kevin: Payment ID stripe_pi_3Kxy... (sent in DM) — charge succeeded on 2024-07-12 14:23 UTC. The original invoice metadata has purchase_order=null. Customer supplied PO in email thread.

jenny: Billing process: for paid invoices we do a credit + reissue with the corrected PO on the new invoice. Need GL code and approver (finance) sign-off. I can create the credit memo once ops confirms the entitlement. :+1:

billing-bot: Automated note — invoice 5421 status: PAID, amount: $12,450.00, currency: USD.

kevin: Thanks. Customer needs the corrected invoice with PO for their AP team before EOD tomorrow. Can we prioritize?

maria: I can approve and attach GL 5200-06. Jenny, can you create the credit memo and reissue flow? I’ll mark as high priority.

jenny: Will do. Quick question — do we reissue from the same invoice number (void + reissue) or issue credit memo then new invoice with new #? Last time we did credit memo + new invoice.

kevin: Customer prefers a single corrected invoice showing the PO. If credit memo + new invoice is the only supported path, we should include a clear cover note for AP explaining both docs.

ops_oncall: FYI, I spotted why PO was dropped — our invoice generation job uses order metadata from the billing API call. If the purchase_order field is not set at charge time and then later updated on the invoice object, the PDF generation path doesn't pick it up unless re-run. Re-run is safe but will create a race if invoice already archived in S3.

maria: Can ops re-run PDF generation after we update invoice metadata? Steps?

ops_oncall: Steps (quick repro / runbook):
1) Update invoice metadata: PATCH /v1/invoices/5421 {"purchase_order":"CL-2024-019"}
2) Trigger PDF regeneration job: POST /internal/invoices/5421/regenerate_pdf
3) Confirm S3 object updated and send to customer.
If invoice status == PAID we still need a credit + new invoice for accounting, but PDF regen gives customer the immediate PO-aligned doc while we process the credit.

kevin: Great. Maria will patch metadata, Jenny will create credit memo + new invoice. Ops will regen PDF and attach to the customer thread. Target timeline: PDF regen within 1h, accounting docs within 24h.

maria: PATCH done — purchase_order set to CL-2024-019.

ops_oncall: Triggering regeneration now. Command: curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood.company/api/internal/invoices/5421/regenerate_pdf" -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx"

billing-bot: PDF regeneration queued — job_id: job_7782, expected completion ~2m.

kevin: I’ll notify Catalyst Labs that corrected PDF will arrive shortly and accounting docs to follow. Thanks all. :heart:

jenny: Creating credit memo now (CM-7782) and issuing new invoice (N-5422). Will attach to thread when ready.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-7782 created, new invoice N-5422 generated and linked to payment (manual rebill required).

kevin: Closing loop — customer confirmed receipt of regenerated PDF and accepts credit+rebill. Marking as resolved after Jenny posts final docs.

jenny: Final docs uploaded to the support ticket and attached here. Closing on our side.

kevin: Thanks everyone! :tada:
